head_initialization: Random 25-channel temporal CNN, no temporal checkpoint loaded
focused_sampling: 150 unique adjacent-date train windows +50 class-focused repeats; persistent/new/extension/extension pattern
objective: Weighted CE + 0.5 class Dice + 0.2 boundary BCE + 0.05 local consistency + 0.3 skeleton-path loss
reported_loss: Training: augmented update batches, pair-count-weighted epoch mean; validation: unaugmented fixed views, same class weights/objective, predicted-root support; end-to-end metrics include missed roots
metric_reference: Uploaded (24).json exactly preserved; internal agreement with user-designated reference, not independent accuracy
initialization_scope: Temporal head only; binary predictions frozen; no learned routing; Prediction-only RGB/binary feature cache reused unchanged; no old temporal probabilities
scheduler: 100-epoch cosine annealing, step after each epoch
selection: Maximum validation end-to-end macro Dice; initial epoch 0 excluded

annotation_semantics.T1_untyped_root: baseline display only, not a training label

outer_partition: All four B3 dates in one development position
evaluation_scope: Inner spatial validation/holdout on one field, not an independent test or cross-tube accuracy
